headline: Approved budget amendment for Sewer Division roof replacement and budget appropriation for Electric Division computer upgrades
summary: The Public Utilities Commission approved the consent agenda, including prior meeting minutes and a sewer liability insurance budget amendment. The commission approved a $10,975.00 budget amendment for the Sewer Division to replace the roof at the Doherty Drive Wastewater Pump Station, and a $65,000.00 budget appropriation for the Electric Division to replace 39 computers running Windows 10. Staff also reported on a letter sent to DEEP regarding RGGI fund distribution.
decisions: Approved the Consent Agenda, including the July 21, 2026 meeting minutes and a Sewer Division budget amendment for liability insurance, 3 ayes.

Approved a Budget Amendment for the Sewer Division FY 2026/2027 in the amount of $10,975.00 from Retained Earnings to Account 46300321 for Pumping and Structure Improvements, for a new roof at the Doherty Drive Wastewater Pump Station, 3 ayes.
Approved a Budget Appropriation for the Electric Division FY 2026/2027 in the amount of $65,000.00 from Retained Earnings to Account 391 General Plant Office Furniture and Equipment, 3 ayes.

74 4. Discussion and Possible Action: Budget Amendment ­ Sewer Division - FY 
75 2026/2027 ­ Pumping and Structure Improvements 
76 
77 Mr. Langenauer stated that following a precipitation event (rain) on June 23, 2026, it was 
78 observed that the roof at the Doherty Drive Wastewater Pump Station experienced storm 
79 damage. Given the age of the original roof, which is 29 years old (the pump station was 
80 constructed in 1997) , it was determined that a complete replacement of the asphalt shingle roof 
81 rather than routine repairs would be the best option. Due to high winds the ridge cap dislodged in 
82 multiple locations , thereby allowing water to infiltrate the pump station structure. In addition , the 
83 soffits are in poor condition and will need to be replaced as part of the overall roof replacement . 
84 Eagle Rivet Roof Services will perform the roof replacement work for $9,975.00 under Public 
85 Bid #18-133, providing the required services at the lowest cost in accordance with the project ' s 
86 bid specifications. The project includes the removal of all existing shingles , replacement of 
87 damaged plywood as needed, installation of a new roof, and replacement of the gutters and soffit.
88 The Sewer Division is requesting PUC approval of a FY 2026 /2027 budget amendment to fund 
89 Account #46300321 - Pumping and Structure Improvements by $10,975.00 which includes a 
90 10% contingency.

93 amount of $10,975.00 from Retained Earnings to Account 46300321 - Pumping and 
94 Structure Improvements adding that "the project is for a new (replacement) roof at the 
95 existing Doherty Drive Wastewater Pump Station to include the removal of all existing 
96 shingles, replacement of damaged plywood as needed, installation of a new asphalt roof, 
97 replacement of the soffits, and installation of gutters and downspouts."

108 Mr. Arborio stated that the WED is seeking a budget appropriation of $65,000.00 which includes 
109 a 10% contingency into Account 391 to procure 39 computers that currently operate on Windows 
110 10. Effective October 2026 , Microsoft will no longer support Windows version 10. At the time 
111 that the Fiscal 2026 /2027 Budget was prepared, there was uncertainty as to the direction the 
112 WED would be taking with respect to Information Technology, specifically computer hardware . 
113 The WED determined that it did not have enough information during the budgeting process to 
114 attempt to accurately estimate what items would need to be procured and the associated costs.
